description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function' which is a data preprocessor for formatting values using user-defined PHP functions within the Image_Graph library. It includes methods for setting the function name and processing values by calling the specified function.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function
classes.description: A data preprocessor class that formats values using a user-defined PHP function.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preprocessor with the name of the PHP function to use.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a value by calling the user-defined function on it.
